notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Connects to MySQL with a password. Used after discovering credentials from config files (mysqld.cnf with plaintext credentials), web app configs (wp-config.php), or other sources.

=== CHAINING ===
Find MySQL credentials in config file → mysql -u user -pPASSWORD -h target → enumerate databases → harvest application data → check privileges for file read/write.

=== WORDPRESS ===
wp-config.php contains DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD in plaintext. MySQL access with these credentials → wp_users table → admin password hash → crack or reset admin password → WordPress admin panel → plugin upload → RCE.
